dog.description_text: Meet Jasper Boy — New Arrival! Jasper Boy just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQAt6_pWBHjnTa8pepq4zmKoAXTwiZFQOt01YtOmCm07Coc?e=51bTk6 Jasper Boy is a 2-year old male. He has been neutered, microchipped, vaccinated, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. His foster says he is sweet and gentle. He settled in nicely and likes to interact. He gets along nicely with the other cat and they play together. His foster loves "His little chirps when he wants attention, then he'll come lay right on top of me and take a nap." The other cat he is housed with, Greyson, is also available for adoption. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
